load() returns a plain merged dict; 9 by-path importers and the CLI callers (config.sh, create-worktree, forge_ledger, collect_env, publish.sh) consume it through get() or attribute access, so the owner filter must live inside load() and keep its dict return; the ignored list and is-set-up need new functions.

validate(config) receives the merged dict with no layer provenance, so it cannot produce the ignored-values list; seed_map refuses on any validate problem and scaffold_of asserts validate()==[] while the scaffold writes `notes:` and `<forge>: remote:` into the committed file — ignored values must be warnings from a layer-aware call, never entries in validate()'s problem list.

Removing credentials-env from CHILD_KEYS makes it an unknown-key error (exit 2), not the designed warning; the monorepo sample carries it and test_shipped_samples_validate requires exit 0; the drift test requires CONFIG.md's jira row to equal CHILD_KEYS. A warn-only removal needs a deprecated-key list outside CHILD_KEYS that the drift test does not read.

The Jira adapter never reads jira.credentials-env: CRED_KEYS is hardcoded and resolved per field env > ~/.claude.json > codex config; api.py names no config reader, so jira.site needs a new by-path import of afk-config.py in adapters/tracker/jira/api.py.

Tests that place a team or moved key in a non-owner layer go red: test_afk_config.py:148 and :179, create-worktree-smoke.sh test 3, test_create_worktree_name.py:208/:217, test_protected_branch_acceptance.py:819, test_precommit_order.py:257.
test_publish_bug selects Jira through AFK_CONFIG while this repository commits tracker: github-issues; with team keys not overridable, publish_bug's import-time tracker load exits.

The design does not say which owner $AFK_CONFIG, .afk/config.local.yaml, or ~/.afk/config.yaml hold for personal and team keys; current readers rely on all three: CONFIG.md:31-35, skills/afk/bug/CONFIG.md:22-24, MANIFEST.md:52, developer_values.py:142-145/183, and tests test_setup_developer_values.py:69, test_setup_h6_probe.py:129, publish-smoke.sh:214.

Adding worktreeRoot or forgeAccount to DEVELOPER_KEYS requires developer_values ORDER, need and suggest tables to grow in the same change (test_the_key_order_covers_the_readers_key_set), and `resolve` accepts only DEVELOPER_KEYS; set's --machine refusal for worktreeBasePath is the inverse of worktreeRoot's machine-only rule.

Owner moves change caller behaviour with no error: a committed github/gitlab remote is dropped and the forge CLI derives the project; protected-lookup falls back to the tracking remote; create-worktree falls back to the DEFAULTS copy list and copy-personal true; the notes kind comes from the home file or the default repo-files.

The effective JSON is the merged dict at top level and test_effective_export_shell_and_get_agree requires every effective path in export-shell; forge_ledger parses .get('review') and falls back silently. The ignored list must stay out of effective and export-shell (as HL-2 says); new shell names are AFK_CFG_JIRA_SITE, AFK_CFG_DEVELOPER_WORKTREEROOT and AFK_CFG_DEVELOPER_FORGEACCOUNT.

create-worktree resolves the default parent with `resolve worktreeBasePath`, discards its exit and stderr, and lands at $HOME/repo-worktrees when nothing resolves; removing or renaming that key without moving this caller sends every --branch/--dir worktree there with only a yellow notice; no test pins this path.
